summary: Install pinned curllm continuous monitoring with user timer

delivery.outcome: Publish reproducible installer and activate continuous curllm monitoring from a merged source revision; preserve foreign primary files and operator configuration (STARTER-019).
nonGoals: No self-authorized source changes or review bypass
No interaction with user browser pages

architecture.decision: Export a merged source revision into a private versioned runtime, verify source checksums and install a serialized user systemd timer. Explicit activation is separate from staging; existing foreign configurations are retained.
interfaceChanges: Add staged installation and explicit timer activation CLI

dataChanges.description: Private release export, external operator configuration, service units and deployment receipt owned by curllm deployment; no foreign data migration.

architecture.rollback: Disable curllm-autonomy.timer; retain state/intake and previous versioned release.

validation.evidence: Merged-ref enforcement, source integrity, interpreter path preservation and existing-file preservation verified.
Installer and native gate pass; actual staged runtime probes succeed.
After independent merge, timer activation and actual probe outcomes read back.
